answer_1.quote: We introduce Tree-of-Debate, a structured multi-persona debate framework, to generate fine-grained contrastive summaries.
datasets: our dataset of 100 paper pairs across natural language processing, data mining, electrical engineering, and aerospace engineering

answer_4.quote: The same domain-experts from Section 4.1 manually evaluate each of their chosen pairs in-depth, assessing various qualities of the 100 summaries.
answer_4.guideline: Each summary is rated from 0-4 on Breadth ('not at all' to 'very') and Contextualization ('not at all' to 'strongly contextualized'), and each sentence is scored 1/0 for Factuality.
